definitions.explanation: An affirmative response, slightly softer than はい.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦わかります→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。」「ええ、⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧。」
「⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦{来|き}ます→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。」「ええ、⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧。」
「⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧、⟦{見|み}ました→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。」「ええ、⟦{先週|せんしゅう}→先週：00752_senshuu⟧⟦{見|み}ました→見る：00283_miru⟧。」
examples.english: "Have you seen this movie?" "Yes, I saw it last week."

examples.japanese: 「⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧⟦いかが→いかが：02846_ikaga⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。」「ええ、⟦いただきます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。」

notes:
ええ is an affirmative interjection used to express agreement or confirmation. It's softer and more conversational than ⟦はい→はい：09574_hai⟧, commonly used in everyday speech.

FORMALITY SCALE (most to least formal):
1. ⟦はい→はい：09574_hai⟧: formal 'yes' (business, polite speech)
2. ええ: conversational 'yes' (everyday polite conversation)
3. ⟦うん→うん：01577_un⟧: casual 'yeah' (friends, family)
4. ⟦ああ→ああ：01147_aa⟧: very casual acknowledgment

USAGE:
- Often used by women more than men in formal situations
- Can be elongated (ええー) to show hesitation or thinking
- Works as a conversation filler showing you're listening
- Softer tone makes it popular in customer service

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ええ、⟦そう→そう：01167_sou⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧: Yes, that's right
- ええ、⟦{分|わ}かりました→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧: Yes, I understand
- ええ、⟦まあ→まあ：03728_maa⟧: Yes, well... (hesitant agreement)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦いいえ→いいえ：02845_iie⟧: no (polite)
- ⟦ううん→ううん：20371_uun⟧: no (casual)
